evidence.observation: T701 reads 433.2 °C while adjacent column temperatures are 69.4–70.2 °C, a pronounced temperature discrepancy.
T701 has risen to 437.9 °C while adjacent column temperatures remain 69.9–70.6 °C; actual overheating versus sensor or data-conversion error is unresolved.
Reflux and distillate flows are 0.2 and 0.4 L/h, giving a quotient of 0.5, whereas the reported flow ratio is 6.8; the ratio definition and measurement synchronization need verification.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and raw-signal/unit checks, protocol temperature limits and heater settings, and FYI702 definition are needed to distinguish physical malfunction from measurement/software error. No composition measurement or separation target is provided. Pressure channels are not installed, so their absence is not a fault.
